$$\frac{\partial I}{\partial q} = -\int_0^\infty \frac{1}{x^2}e^{-px^2-q/x^2}dx.$$
Substitute $u = \sqrt{q/p}/x$ (so $x = \sqrt{q/p}/u$, $dx = -\sqrt{q/p}\,u^{-2}du$). The integral transforms to:
$$\frac{\partial I}{\partial q} = -\sqrt{\frac{p}{q}}\int_0^\infty e^{-pu^2 - q/u^2}du = -\sqrt{\frac{p}{q}}\,I(p,q).$$
